answer: Every claim climbs the zenith of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the delta re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. By the signal of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, split across independent auditors, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
